profile.bio: Biochemistry and Biotechnology undergraduate with research interests in neuroscience, molecular biology, cancer biology, and computational drug discovery.
profile.researchInterests: Neuroscience, molecular biology, cancer biology, and computational drug discovery. My work combines collaborative research, scientific writing, bioinformatics, computer-aided drug design, and molecular modelling with ongoing wet-lab and computational projects.
profile.currentResearch: Wet-lab projects on Lasia spinosa root extracts (nutritional and diuretic activity) and Cordyceps militaris extracts (antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer potential), alongside computational drug-discovery work on PRMT5 inhibitors and CBP/p300 bromodomain interactions in acute myeloid leukemia.

aboutMe.title: Hlw, This is Rafi
aboutMe.subtitle: I'm an undergraduate student and researcher
aboutMe.description: Passionate about biomedical research, with a particular interest in neuroscience, cancer biology, neuroinflammation, and computational drug discovery. Experienced in conducting collaborative research involving computer-aided drug design, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, bioinformatics, and wet-laboratory investigations to explore potential therapeutic candidates and understand disease mechanisms. Developing scientific and technical expertise in molecular biology, natural product research, data analysis, and interdisciplinary biomedical research. Actively engaged in scientific writing, research collaborations, and academic communication, with contributions to preprints, peer-reviewed book chapters, and ongoing research projects. Aspiring to pursue a PhD and contribute to innovative approaches in biomedical science and therapeutic development.
